verdict.rationale: Veriff auto-provisions free test integrations for development (sessions don't count toward paid usage), and its docs say decisions can be triggered for test-integration sessions, manually via the Verifications page in the Customer Portal. That lets a developer force outcomes, but it relies on manual portal action rather than documented magic values or test personas that drive results deterministically through the API. Missing for 10: documented test documents, personas or magic values; an explicit list of triggerable outcomes (pass/fail/review); programmatic, automatable outcome triggering; independent or hands-on corroboration.
